alert.title: C2 Beacon Detected, block not independently confirmed

result.hint: prior TruePositive case matched this indicator

label_notes: Spec-derived from Phase 2's independent-verification requirement (L1-L2-SAFETY-AUDIT.md §8): eligible + guard-allowed but NOT independently verified contained falls back to L2 with CONTAINMENT_UNVERIFIED, never closes L1 on Cortex's self-report alone. must_not_auto_contain=False (not True) because the underlying verdict is genuinely malicious and correctly-eligible — this is a 'not yet verified' state, not a 'must never contain' one; also covers 'closure-verification failure -> L2 fallback' (containment verification IS this policy's closure-verification step, per l1_disposition()'s own docstring vocabulary).
